title: P vs NP: The Question That Could Break the Internet
question: Is verifying a solution always fundamentally easier than finding one from scratch — or could every hard problem secretly have a fast shortcut we simply haven't discovered?
summary: P vs NP is a one-million-dollar unsolved math problem with a strange property: almost everyone believes they know the answer, yet no one can prove it. The answer would either validate the security of the entire internet or shatter it overnight.
